name: windy-plugin-flight-route-analyzer
description: ICAO route visualizer, UTC GPX export, native route/time handoff, navdata and diagnostics (no paid forecast API)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/package.json
scripts.typecheck:core: tsc --noEmit --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --lib es2022,dom --strict src/navdb.ts src/xplane.ts src/routeGpx.ts src/gpxDownload.ts src/nativePlannerHandoff.ts
scripts.test: tsc --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --lib es2022,dom --outDir tests/generated src/navdb.ts src/xplane.ts src/routeGpx.ts src/gpxDownload.ts src/nativePlannerHandoff.ts && node tools/fix-generated-imports.mjs && node tests/test.mjs && node tests/test_xplane.mjs && node tests/test_github_snapshot.mjs && node tests/test_route_gpx.mjs && node tests/test_gpx_download.mjs && node tests/test_native_planner_handoff.mjs && node tests/test_simplified_ui.mjs && python3 tests/test_navdata_converter.py && npm run check:startup
scripts.test:release: npm run check:tree && npm run check:build-config && npm run check:imports && npm run check:exports && npm run typecheck:core && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:release

author: Prototype
